metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly fleece for your team. Soft, durable, and perfect for embroidery or screen printing. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Cotton poly fleece blends the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making it a smart choice for branded apparel that needs to hold up through repeated wear and washing. Unlike 100% cotton fleece, this blend resists shrinking and fading, so your logo stays sharp. Ideal for company jackets, hoodies, and quarter-zip pullovers, cotton poly fleece takes screen printing and embroidery equally well. Safety managers and HR directors often choose this fabric for uniform programs where comfort and longevity both matter.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly fleece jackets and hoodies with embroidered logos, soft and durable for team uniforms
